name: SurplusIQ Hamilton Docket Bridge
description: Local-run helper for SurplusIQ. Drives the Hamilton County Clerk (courtclerk.org) case search in genuine Chrome (Cloudflare Turnstile issues its token to a real browser) and hands the docket back to the local runner over 127.0.0.1. Load unpacked into the hamilton-oh profile; used only by `python -m core.dockets.hamilton`.
